source.title: RoboMaster 2027 机甲大师超级对抗赛比赛规则手册

simulation_assumptions.armor_model: finite rectangular robot/base/outpost armor planes with separate solid body and opening-cover occlusion; approximate structure geometry is public

drone_impact.note: manual thresholds are TBD; a valid strike also wears one guard integrity point

drone_projectile_hits.note: projectiles push drones by their momentum; guards stop them from reaching the rotors

ground_camera_fov_deg.note: Ground FPV follows the physical muzzle direction and chassis pose. Own robot state and referee telemetry remain unrestricted; aerial vision keeps its existing coverage.

simulation_assumptions.hardware_authority: robot_designs is authoritative; family specs speed/acceleration are retained only for old SDK compatibility

launcher_install.note: workbench fitting time and tolerance are design choices; the module adds its mass to the chassis

simulation_assumptions.manual_judging: Illegal target and zone commands prevented; subjective human penalties and real hardware failures are not randomly simulated.
simulation_assumptions.map_fidelity: Chapter 4 dimensioned module footprints and figure4-5 placement; unlabelled joints reconstructed from the plan, not rulebook CAD.
simulation_assumptions.note: 2027 additions and replacements over simulation_assumptions; manual-silent hardware and timing choices.
simulation_assumptions.physics_engine: rapier3d-f64 0.26.1 enhanced-determinism; 120Hz rigid bodies and ray suspension

pickup_phases.note: Requires actual arm contact, closing, lift and storage. Keep pick_unit true; leaving, destruction, weakness or manual arm control cancels.

simulation_assumptions.robot_hardware: 19 selectable symmetric hardware designs; default six-model lineup preserved; construction bounds enforced

rune_motor.note: Small and idle large runes rotate at pi/3 rad/s; active large runes use a*sin(omega*t)+2.090-a, reset on each new large activation; both faces share the shaft.

structure_geometry.note: Finite proxies reconstructed from manual figures 4-10/11/32; unlabelled armor centers and motion are simulation assumptions, not rulebook CAD.

construction_inspection.source: built-in cardinal armor mounts; analytic chassis geometry; declared clearance cones
